title: Two machines, one session list
highlights: Two machines can be paired over mutual TLS, after which either one can open and drive a session running on the other
The session picker lists what your paired machines are running and opens those sessions without leaving the TUI
/memory clean now works from inside a session and asks before it deletes anything
improvements: The session list groups sessions by the machine they belong to, and 'arterm device sessions' shows the same across every paired machine
Choosing one of this machine's sessions after switching to another machine brings the client back here, instead of asking the other machine for a session it has never heard of
A paired machine that is asleep or off the network no longer holds up the session list; it simply contributes no rows
fixes: 'arterm memory clean' reported success while deleting nothing, because it never resolved the project it was run in
Cleaning a project's memory left its backup copies on disk
'arterm device join --help' advertised port 7420; the default is 7644
Pairing could not accept incoming connections on Windows
